title: Flower Of Eternity
description:
The project is a Discord bot.

Bot features:
— Flexible event logging system.
— Event handler.
— Economy system that lets users send currency and view balance and transaction
history, while Administration can grant or seize currency, check users' balances
and view their transaction history.
— A "Coin Flip" game.
— Flexible bot configuration, allowing general bot, economy,
module, command and game settings to be edited.
